symptom: On the pinned Draft research PR, the deprecated task mode exits 3, but any unrecognized positional mode other than validate-request could bypass that exact-string guard, parse a valid request, and reach the legacy queue/executor branch. This is static conditional reachability, not an observed execution, workflow dispatch, or N2 activation. A separate fail-closed unknown-mode gate and non-executing regression were added on the Draft PR; canonical main remains unchanged.
lesson: Disabling one deprecated subcommand by exact string is insufficient when unknown positional modes share a default execution fallthrough. Restrict request parsing to the explicitly supported validate-request mode and reject all other modes before request, lock, queue or executor access.
guardrail: Keep the explicit unknown-mode fail-closed exit 3 before legacy request parsing, alongside the task-mode exit. Preserve static source-order and no-request subprocess checks for run-task, execute and case-variant aliases. Do not run a valid legacy request or protected N2 for diagnostics; leave workflow disablement to separately approved operations.
